title: "Installing Seurat"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: united
    df_print: kable
---

To install Seurat, [R](https://www.r-project.org/) version 4.0 or greater is required. We also recommend installing [RStudio](https://www.rstudio.com/).

# Install from CRAN

Seurat is available on [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Seurat) for all systems. To install, run:

```{r, eval = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
install.packages("Seurat")
library(Seurat)
```

Optional packages, developed by other labs, can substantially improve Seurat's speed and performance.

These include [presto](https://github.com/immunogenomics/presto) (Korsunsky/Raychaudhuri Labs), [BPCells](https://github.com/bnprks/BPCells) (Greenleaf Lab), and [glmGamPoi](https://github.com/const-ae/glmGamPoi) (Huber Lab). To install these packages, run:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
setRepositories(ind = 1:3, addURLs = c("https://satijalab.r-universe.dev", "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev/"))
install.packages(c( "presto", "BPCells", "glmGamPoi"))
```

We also recommend installing the following additional packages, which enhance the functionality of Seurat and are used in our vignettes (see the [**Extensions**](extensions.html) page for more details):

```{r additional, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("Signac")

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}

remotes::install_github("satijalab/seurat-data")
remotes::install_github("satijalab/azimuthapi")
remotes::install_github("satijalab/rna-fingerprinting")
remotes::install_github("satijalab/seurat-wrappers")
```

# Install the development version

The development version of Seurat is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/tree/main).

<div class="alert alert-info"> <strong>Note:</strong>  If Seurat has already been loaded (e.g., via `library(Seurat)`), restart your R session after installing a different version to avoid version conflicts. </div>

To install the development version, run:

```{r eval = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}

remotes::install_github(repo = "satijalab/seurat", ref = "main")
library(Seurat)
```

# Install previous versions

Seurat v4 & older versions of Seurat, from Seurat v2.0.1 and up, are hosted in CRAN's archive. To install, run:

```{r eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}

# Replace X.X.X with your desired version
remotes::install_version(package = "Seurat", version = package_version("X.X.X"))
```

For versions of Seurat older than those hosted on CRAN (versions 1.3.0 and 1.4.0), please download the packaged source code as a tarball (`.tar.gz`) from our [releases page](https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/releases) and install via:

```{r eval = FALSE}
install.packages("/path/to/Seurat_X.X.X.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```

# Use `pak` for installs

Users may find [pak](https://pak.r-lib.org/) useful for quickly and easily installing Seurat and other packages:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}

pak::pkg_install("Seurat")

# Packages to improve speed and performance
pak::repo_add(satijalab = "https://satijalab.r-universe.dev", bnprks = "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev")
pak::pkg_install(c("BPCells", "presto", "glmGamPoi"))

# Packages to extend functionality
pak::pkg_install("Signac")
pak::pkg_install("satijalab/seurat-data")
pak::pkg_install("satijalab/azimuthapi")
pak::pkg_install("satijalab/rna-fingerprinting")
pak::pkg_install("satijalab/seurat-wrappers")

# Development version
pak::pkg_install("satijalab/seurat@main")

# Previous version on CRAN
pak::pkg_install("Seurat@X.X.X")

# Early versions via source tarball
pak::pkg_install("local::/path/to/Seurat_X.X.X.tar.gz")
```

# Docker

We provide Docker images for Seurat via [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/r/satijalab/seurat).

_Note: packages in these images may be installed from CRAN or Posit Package Manager (RSPM), which supplies precompiled binaries of CRAN releases._

To pull the latest image from the command line:

```sh
docker pull satijalab/seurat:latest
```

To use as a base image in a new Dockerfile:

```sh
FROM satijalab/seurat:latest
```
